newsitem.title: UK: UK steel production up 4.4pct y/y in October - Bispa.
newsitem.headline: UK steel production up 4.4pct y/y in October - Bispa.

text.p: Production of steel in Britain in October rose by 4.4 percent over the same year-ago period and by 5.5 percent month-on-month, the British Iron and Steel Producers Association (Bispa) said on Thursday.

In a statement Bispa said the average October production rate of 374,300 tonnes per week meant that for the first 10 months of 1996 the rate of production has fallen marginally since the same period last year.
For the year so far production is running at 344,500 tonnes per week, or 14.81 million tonnes actual, compared to 345,700 tonnes per week, or 14.86 million last year.
